entities.summary: Ponaka Kanakamma (1892–1963) was an Indian social worker, activist and freedom fighter, who was imprisoned over a year, as a disciple of Mahatma Gandhi. She founded Sri Kasturidevi Vidyalayam, a high school for girls in Nellore.
